text:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Increased 502s and upstream timeouts observed across gateway-api in us-west1. Error rate 5xx up ~4x over baseline. Paging mira (oncall SRE). /severity:page

mira (oncall SRE): I'm on it. Observing spike in 502s and a tight cluster of timeouts to backend 'model-router'. Any deploys in last 15m? :eyes:

dev (gateway eng): no user-triggered deploys in last hour. deploy-bot shows a healthcheck config change 40m ago but not a rolling deploy. I can jump on a datadog tail if you want.

mira (oncall SRE): yes please dev, start a live tail. I'm gathering top failing endpoints.

dev (gateway eng): grabbing logs: `kubectl logs -n prod gateway-api -l app=gateway --since=10m`

dev (gateway eng): snippet from logs:```
2026-03-15T18:12:02Z gateway-api service req_id=--- upstream=model-router status=502 "upstream read timeout"
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z gateway-api service req_id=--- upstream=model-router status=502 "upstream reset"
```

mira (oncall SRE): I see lots of requests with missing request-id header (req_id=---). That correlates with our trace sampling drop. Raj, any chance traces are being dropped at the ingress sampler?

raj (observability): yup, looking now. Our sampling policy had a config rollback yesterday to reduce cost; looks like a rule accidentally excluded small payloads from sampling. Traces exist for ~10% of requests. Metrics are intact but traces/logs are sparse.

mira (oncall SRE): customer-impact check: sam, any CS reports?

sam (support): a few customers reported slow responses and UI errors 502 around 18:12. No large outage tickets yet. Flagged a handful of enterprise customers in us-west.

mira (oncall SRE): escalation: sev2. We need a stopgap to surface request IDs and traces quickly and reduce 5xx. Priorities: (1) add temporary request-id middleware to gateway to ensure we can correlate logs/traces, (2) bump trace sampling in us-west to 100% for 30m, (3) apply short-term routing fallback to healthy pool.

dev (gateway eng): I can hotpatch the gateway with a lightweight middleware that injects X-Request-ID when missing and log it at debug. Patch ready:```
kubectl patch deployment/gateway-api -n prod --patch '\n{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"hotpatch":"inject-reqid-2026-03-15"}},"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"HOTPATCH_INJECT_REQID","value":"true"}]}]}}}'
```

mira (oncall SRE): go for it, but keep rollout to 1 pod first (canary). Also add a header dump to logs for quick correlation.

dev (gateway eng): canary rolled: `kubectl rollout status deployment/gateway-api -n prod --watch` -> pod accepted. Logs show injected header now:
`req_id=generated-0a3f`

alice (SRE): I've added a short-term log-forward rule to tag logs with `temp-reqid-probe` so we can search quickly in the logging UI. Also increased retention to help the postmortem.

raj (observability): bumping trace sampling for us-west via tracing control plane now:```
# tracing api
POST /api/v1/sampling-rules
{ "scope": "us-west1", "rate": 1.0, "ttl": 1800 }
```
Applied — sampling now at 100% for 30m. Expect flood of spans.

mira (oncall SRE): watch for ingestion pressure. Raj, if ingest rate looks risky, lower to 50% but keep key endpoints at 100% via path-based rule.

raj (observability): seeing spike in spans but within buffer. I created a path rule for `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat` at 100% and global at 50% in case we need to throttle.

dev (gateway eng): another quick mitigation: for requests showing repeated upstream timeouts, I'm flipping failing backend routing to fallback pool `model-router-b`. Command:```
kubectl set env deployment/route-controller ROUTE_FAILOVER=true -n prod
```
This will route new requests to the warm b-pool.

mira (oncall SRE): approved. Flip it, monitor latency and 5xx.

deploy-bot: rollout started for route-controller -> rollout/route-controller 1/3 updated.

dev (gateway eng): route failover active. Early signal: 5xx dropping from 4x to 1.8x within 3m. Latency for fallback slightly higher but successful.

sam (support): passing note to affected enterprise contacts: "We're investigating increased 502s in us-west and have applied mitigations; you may observe slightly higher latency while we reroute to healthy capacity. We'll follow up with timeline."

pm (product): please collect an impact summary for customers hit and confirm any data loss risk. We need a short blurb for status page.

mira (oncall SRE): immediate risk of data loss is low; primarily transient 5xx/responses. I'm tracking error counts per customer now and will post ETA for full mitigation.

alice (SRE): additional stopgap instrumentation: added a temporary exported metric `gateway.missing_reqid.count` (increment when req id is injected) and a dashboard panel for `502_by_backend` and `missing_reqid` correlation.

raj (observability): also added a high-cardinality log index for `temp-reqid-probe` and created a quick query:```
logs("service:gateway-api AND tags:temp-reqid-probe")| json | count by backend, status_code
```
Using that to map error bursts to upstream hosts.

mira (oncall SRE): summary so far: 1) missing request-ids + reduced trace sampling limited our observability, 2) upstream pool `model-router` had intermittent overload causing timeouts, 3) we applied req-id injection, increased tracing sampling, temporary routing to fallback pool, and log tagging. 5xx dropping but not back to baseline yet.

dev (gateway eng): ongoing: a fast config fix landed to model-router to limit concurrency per worker; will monitor for CPU/memory side effects.

mira (oncall SRE): next actions: - keep sampling at 100% for critical endpoints for another 10m, then reduce to 25% with path rules - keep req-id injection for 60m then revert if stable - rotate a canary of model-router back to green after config fix - prepare postmortem runbook entries for missing sampling guardrails

sam (support): I've updated customers and added a follow-up note that we will provide a postmortem.

pm (product): thanks. Please post a short status update for status.redwoood.com: "Mitigations applied; error rate improving; interim trace/log instrumentation added to aid root cause. Follow-up with full incident report."

mira (oncall SRE): placing incident in monitoring mode. If 5xx rate does not fall to <=1.2x baseline in 20m we escalate to infra incident lead.

dev (gateway eng): observed 5xx at 1.15x baseline for last 5m. Looks promising.

raj (observability): traces and logs now correlate for many of the previously opaque requests. Saved sample spans and log slices to a Jira ticket `INC-4567` for postmortem.

mira (oncall SRE): closing the pager for now, we will keep this thread live and collect artifacts. Thanks all for the quick patching. :heart:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to page-notify. Please update oncall notes and runbook after postmortem.
